kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انعتقت (form VII)
# اِنْعَتَقْتُ (inʕataqtu) /in.ʕa.taq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# اِنْعَتَقْتَ (inʕataqta) /in.ʕa.taq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# اِنْعَتَقْتِ (inʕataqti) /in.ʕa.taq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# اِنْعَتَقَتْ (inʕataqat) /in.ʕa.ta.qat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
